items.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: he asked me to be the regular bass player... we kind of developed a duo... trio is kind of different

ctx.x: Yeah. We had — Junior had a concert last October in Israel. We had like seven concerts.

Well I wanted to start out — I saw something on your website that I thought was well- said. And someone was talking about you and it talked about when you finally got to New York. “He started the jazz life that he had always dreamed of.” So you had always dreamed of a jazz life?
